verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs show tasks can be created from Jira/GitHub/Linear tickets and describe selecting workflow phases (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented) based on how well-scoped the requested change is, which implies some automatic scoping of described work into a task structure. However, there is no explicit documentation of a developer typing a free-form feature/bug description directly into HumanLayer and having it auto-decomposed into a scoped implementation plan — the closest evidence is issue-tracker-driven task creation and workflow selection guidance, not a described plain-language-to-spec pipeline. Missing for 10: a documented flow showing raw natural-language input being parsed/scoped into a structured task spec, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this conversion working.
